WITH date_range AS (
  SELECT DATE '2017-01-01' + CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS sale_date
  FROM (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, 585)) AS n)
),
daily_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS sale_date,
    SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
    AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
    AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
  GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
with_daynum AS (
  SELECT 
    dr.sale_date,
    COALESCE(ds.daily_sales, 0) AS daily_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dr.sale_date) AS day_num
  FROM date_range dr
  LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds ON dr.sale_date = ds.sale_date
  WHERE dr.sale_date >= '2017-01-01' AND dr.sale_date <= '2018-08-29'
),
regression AS (
  SELECT 
    REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
    REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
  FROM with_daynum
),
all_dates_for_predictions AS (
  SELECT DATE '2017-01-01' + CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS sale_date
  FROM (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, 730)) AS n)
),
all_with_daynum AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.sale_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ad.sale_date) AS day_num
  FROM all_dates_for_predictions ad
  WHERE ad.sale_date >= '2017-01-01' AND ad.sale_date <= '2019-01-05'
),
predicted AS (
  SELECT 
    awd.sale_date,
    awd.day_num,
    r.slope * awd.day_num + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
  FROM all_with_daynum awd
  CROSS JOIN regression r
),
target_dates AS (
  SELECT DATE '2018-12-05' AS target_date
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-06'
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-07'
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-08'
),
moving_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    td.target_date,
    AVG(p1.predicted_sales) AS moving_avg_5day
  FROM target_dates td
  JOIN predicted p1 ON p1.sale_date BETWEEN td.target_date - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND td.target_date + INTERVAL '2' DAY
  GROUP BY td.target_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) AS sum_of_5day_moving_averages FROM moving_averages

-- Final comprehensive RFM analysis
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as order_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        -- Recency: days since the latest purchase timestamp from the reference date (2018-10-17 17:30:18)
        CAST(datediff('day', MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), CAST('2018-10-17 17:30:18' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as frequency,
        SUM(order_total) as monetary
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) as r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency ASC) as f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary ASC) as m_score
    FROM customer_rfm
),
rfm_with_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) as rfm_score,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        CAST(monetary AS DOUBLE) / CAST(frequency AS DOUBLE) as avg_sales_per_order,
        recency_days,
        r_score + f_score + m_score as rfm_sum,
        CASE 
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can_t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END as rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) as avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) as avg_monetary,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) as avg_frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) as avg_recency_days
FROM rfm_with_segment
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

-- Full query with lifespan calculation
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as num_orders,
        MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) as min_purchase,
        MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) as max_purchase
    FROM orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        co.customer_id,
        co.num_orders,
        cp.total_payment,
        cp.total_payment * 1.0 / co.num_orders as avg_payment_per_order,
        GREATEST(date_diff('day', co.min_purchase, co.max_purchase) * 1.0 / 7, 1.0) as lifespan_weeks
    FROM customer_orders co
    JOIN customer_payments cp ON co.customer_id = cp.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    num_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS player_count,
  ROUND(AVG(
    ROUND(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE))) AS DOUBLE), 2)
    + ROUND(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE))) AS DOUBLE) / 12.0, 2)
    + ROUND(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE))) AS DOUBLE) / 365.0, 2)
  ), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM player 
WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''

WITH career_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_g,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_r,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_h,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_hr
  FROM batting
  GROUP BY player_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    career_g,
    career_r,
    career_h,
    career_hr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_g DESC) as rank_g,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_r DESC) as rank_r,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_h DESC) as rank_h,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_hr DESC) as rank_hr
  FROM career_stats
)
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'games_played' as category,
  r.career_g as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_g = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'runs' as category,
  r.career_r as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_r = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'hits' as category,
  r.career_h as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_h = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'home_runs' as category,
  r.career_hr as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_hr = 1
ORDER BY score DESC

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        f.departure_airport,
        f.arrival_airport,
        dep.city as dep_city,
        arr.city as arr_city,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
    WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
),
with_distance AS (
    SELECT 
        6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
            POWER(SIN((dep_lat - arr_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
            + COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) * POWER(SIN((dep_lon - arr_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
        )) as distance_km
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) as max_distance_km FROM with_distance

WITH airport_info AS (
  SELECT 
    airport_code,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(TRY_CAST(city AS VARCHAR), '"en": "', 2), '"', 1) as city_en,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', 2), ',', 1)::DOUBLE as longitude,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 2), ')', 1)::DOUBLE as latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flight_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a1.city_en as from_city,
    a2.city_en as to_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POW(SIN(RADIANS(a2.latitude - a1.latitude) / 2), 2) +
      COS(RADIANS(a1.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(a2.latitude)) *
      POW(SIN(RADIANS(a2.longitude - a1.longitude) / 2), 2)
    )) as distance
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airport_info a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
  JOIN airport_info a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
  WHERE a1.city_en != a2.city_en
),
city_pair_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN from_city ELSE to_city END as city1,
    CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN to_city ELSE from_city END as city2,
    AVG(distance) as avg_distance
  FROM flight_distances
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
city_pair_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM city_pair_avg
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM city_pair_buckets
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as fewest_pair_count
FROM range_counts

-- Final fatality rate calculation by helmet usage group
-- Numerator: total motorcyclist fatalities in collisions with that helmet status
-- Denominator: total collisions with that helmet status

WITH motorcycle_collisions AS (
    SELECT case_id, motorcyclist_killed_count
    FROM collisions
    WHERE motorcycle_collision = 1
),
helmet_used_collisions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id
    FROM parties p
    WHERE (p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%')
),
helmet_not_used_collisions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id
    FROM parties p
    WHERE (p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%')
),
group1 AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
        SUM(mc.motorcyclist_killed_count) as total_motorcyclist_fatalities,
        1.0 * SUM(mc.motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(*) * 100 as fatality_rate_pct
    FROM motorcycle_collisions mc
    INNER JOIN helmet_used_collisions hu ON mc.case_id = hu.case_id
),
group2 AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
        SUM(mc.motorcyclist_killed_count) as total_motorcyclist_fatalities,
        1.0 * SUM(mc.motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(*) * 100 as fatality_rate_pct
    FROM motorcycle_collisions mc
    INNER JOIN helmet_not_used_collisions hnu ON mc.case_id = hnu.case_id
)
SELECT 
    'helmet used' as helmet_group,
    total_collisions,
    total_motorcyclist_fatalities,
    ROUND(fatality_rate_pct, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM group1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'helmet not used' as helmet_group,
    total_collisions,
    total_motorcyclist_fatalities,
    ROUND(fatality_rate_pct, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM group2

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.db_year,
    col.pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM collisions col
  JOIN case_ids c ON col.case_id = c.case_id
  WHERE col.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND col.pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY c.db_year, col.pcf_violation_category
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT db_year, pcf_violation_category, cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY db_year ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM yearly_counts
),
top2_per_year AS (
  SELECT db_year, pcf_violation_category, cnt
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
),
overall_top2 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 2
)
SELECT 
  t.db_year,
  string_agg(t.pcf_violation_category, ', ' ORDER BY t.cnt DESC) as top2_causes,
  (SELECT string_agg(ot.pcf_violation_category, ', ' ORDER BY ot.pcf_violation_category) FROM overall_top2 ot) as overall_top2
FROM top2_per_year t
GROUP BY t.db_year
ORDER BY t.db_year;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(collision_date, 1, 4) as year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_count,
    COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM collisions 
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY substr(collision_date, 1, 4)
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    100.0 * speeding_count / total_count as share
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  shares_2011.year as year_2011,
  shares_2021.year as year_2021,
  ROUND(shares_2011.share, 4) as share_2011,
  ROUND(shares_2021.share, 4) as share_2021,
  ROUND(shares_2011.share - shares_2021.share, 4) as decrease_in_percentage_points
FROM shares shares_2011
JOIN shares shares_2021 ON TRUE
WHERE shares_2011.year = '2011' AND shares_2021.year = '2021'

SELECT DISTINCT b.name, w1.name AS winner_name, w2.name AS loser_name, m.duration
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id::TEXT
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id::TEXT
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id::TEXT
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration != ''
  AND m.duration IS NOT NULL
  AND b.name = 'NXT Championship'
  AND m.duration = '00:43'

-- Final query with integer cast
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) AS BIGINT) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
max_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) AS max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT om.match_id, om.over_id, om.innings_no, om.bowler, om.total_runs
    FROM over_runs om
    JOIN max_per_match mm ON om.match_id = mm.match_id
    WHERE om.total_runs = mm.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id) as rn
    FROM max_overs
)
SELECT bm.bowler AS player_id, p.player_name, bm.match_id, bm.total_runs AS runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max bm
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bm.rn = 1
ORDER BY bm.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Double check: get all bowlers with at least 1 wicket, ordered by bowling average
WITH bowler_deliveries AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, 
           COUNT(*) as deliveries,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT bd.bowler, p.player_name, bd.total_runs_conceded, bw.wickets, bd.deliveries,
       ROUND(1.0 * bd.total_runs_conceded / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_avg
FROM bowler_deliveries bd
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON bd.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON bd.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 5

-- Final calculation: average of total runs scored by all strikers who scored >50 runs in at least one single match
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker, bbs.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs_in_match
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
      ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbs.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs_in_match > 50
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS avg_total_runs
FROM (
    SELECT s.striker, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
      ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    JOIN qualifying_strikers s ON bbb.striker = s.striker
    GROUP BY s.striker
)

-- Get distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match while playing for the losing team
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bbb.team_batting,
        bbb.innings_no,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
        ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, bbb.team_batting, bbb.innings_no
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN player_match pm ON pmr.match_id = pm.match_id AND pmr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE pm.team_id = pmr.team_batting
  AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name;

-- Complete query: top 5 players by average runs per match in season 5
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    WHERE wt.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pm.matches_played as avg_runs_per_match,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pd.dismissals ELSE NULL END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    pm.matches_played,
    COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) as dismissals
FROM player_matches pm
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON pm.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pm.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH player_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pm.player_id, pm.match_id
    FROM player_match pm
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        b.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id,
        COALESCE(pmr.total_runs_in_match, 0) AS runs_in_match
    FROM player_matches pm
    LEFT JOIN player_match_runs pmr ON pm.player_id = pmr.player_id AND pm.match_id = pmr.match_id
),
player_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_in_match) * 1.0 / COUNT(match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_totals
    GROUP BY player_id
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT

        AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_avg

-- Final query: For each match, find the (over_id, innings_no) with highest total runs
-- Combine batsman runs and extra runs per ball, then aggregate per over
-- Get the bowler from ball_by_ball
-- Calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches
WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs,
        b.bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
max_over AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id ASC, innings_no ASC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM max_over
WHERE rn = 1

    FROM olist_geolocation
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS rn
    FROM distinct_geos
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        prev.rn AS prev_rn,
        prev.geolocation_state AS prev_state, 
        prev.geolocation_city AS prev_city, 
        prev.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS prev_zip, 
        prev.geolocation_lat AS prev_lat, 
        prev.geolocation_lng AS prev_lng,
        curr.geolocation_state AS curr_state, 
        curr.geolocation_city AS curr_city, 
        curr.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS curr_zip, 
        curr.geolocation_lat AS curr_lat, 
        curr.geolocation_lng AS curr_lng,
        COS(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lng))
        + SIN(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lat)) AS acos_arg
    FROM numbered prev
    JOIN numbered curr ON prev.rn = curr.rn - 1
)
SELECT 
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    prev_zip,
    prev_lat,
    prev_lng,
    curr_state,
    curr_city,
    curr_zip,
    curr_lat,
    curr_lng,
    6371 * ACOS(LEAST(GREATEST(acos_arg, -1.0), 1.0)) AS distance_km
FROM pairs
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, s.prod_id
),
pivot_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
        AND MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
),
growth AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2020,
        sales_2019,
        ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0)) as growth_rate
    FROM pivot_sales
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2020,
        sales_2020 + ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0)) * sales_2020 as projected_sales
    FROM growth
),
with_exchange AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_sales * c.to_us as projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    t.calendar_month_desc as month,
    ROUND(AVG(w.projected_sales_usd), 2) as avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM with_exchange w
JOIN times t ON t.calendar_year = 2021 AND t.calendar_month_number = w.calendar_month_number
GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc, w.calendar_month_number
ORDER BY w.calendar_month_number

-- Final answer: median of projected monthly USD sales for France 2021
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_month_desc,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND p.promo_total_id = 1
        AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_month_desc
),
sales_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        (((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / sales_2019) * sales_2020) + sales_2020 as projected_2021_local
    FROM sales_pivot
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT
        p.calendar_month_number,
        ROUND(p.projected_2021_local * c.to_us, 2) as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT MEDIAN(projected_2021_usd) as median_projected_sales_usd
FROM with_currency

-- Get all Italian customer profits in Dec 2021 and assign buckets using NTILE
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id, 
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND t.calendar_year = 2021
      AND t.calendar_month_name = 'December'
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cust_id, total_profit,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS bucket
    FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT bucket, 
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS min_profit,
       ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

-- Final query: tier labels, highest and lowest profits per tier
WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id, SUM((p.unit_price - p.unit_cost) * p.quantity_sold) AS total_profit
  FROM profits p
  JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52770
    AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT cust_id, total_profit, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS tier
  FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT 
  'Tier ' || tier AS tier_label,
  ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit,
  ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

WITH cn_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
    AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2021-07-01'
    AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) <= DATE '2021-07-31'
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT insert_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) as rn
  FROM cn_dates
),
groups AS (
  SELECT insert_date,
         insert_date - CAST(rn AS INTEGER) as grp
  FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT grp,
         MIN(insert_date) as streak_start,
         MAX(insert_date) as streak_end,
         COUNT(*) as streak_length
  FROM groups
  GROUP BY grp
),
shortest_streak AS (
  SELECT streak_start, streak_end, streak_length
  FROM streaks
  ORDER BY streak_length ASC, streak_start ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
longest_streak AS (
  SELECT streak_start, streak_end, streak_length
  FROM streaks
  ORDER BY streak_length DESC, streak_start ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
target_dates AS (
  SELECT streak_start, streak_end, streak_length, 'shortest' as streak_type
  FROM shortest_streak
  UNION ALL
  SELECT streak_start, streak_end, streak_length, 'longest' as streak_type
  FROM longest_streak
)
SELECT td.streak_type,
       CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) as date,
       upper(substring(c.city_name, 1, 1)) || lower(substring(c.city_name, 2)) as city_name
FROM cities c
JOIN target_dates td ON CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) BETWEEN td.streak_start AND td.streak_end
WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
ORDER BY td.streak_type, CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE), c.city_name

WITH june_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as rn
  FROM june_dates
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date, rn,
         (insert_date::DATE - (rn - 1) * INTERVAL '1' DAY) as streak_id
  FROM numbered
),
streak_lengths AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, streak_id, COUNT(*) as streak_len
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_id
),
max_streaks AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, MAX(streak_len) as max_len
  FROM streak_lengths
  GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT country_code_2, max_len
FROM max_streaks
WHERE max_len = (SELECT MAX(max_len) FROM max_streaks)
ORDER BY country_code_2

WITH ir_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir' AND insert_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
),
ir_with_groups AS (
  SELECT insert_date,
         insert_date - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS grp
  FROM ir_dates
),
grp_lengths AS (
  SELECT grp, 
         MIN(insert_date) AS start_date, 
         MAX(insert_date) AS end_date,
         COUNT(*) AS length
  FROM ir_with_groups
  GROUP BY grp
),
longest_grp AS (
  SELECT start_date, end_date
  FROM grp_lengths
  ORDER BY length DESC, start_date ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  'ir' AS country_code_2,
  (SELECT start_date FROM longest_grp) AS start_date,
  (SELECT end_date FROM longest_grp) AS end_date,
  1.0 * (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
         FROM cities 
         WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir' 
         AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT start_date FROM longest_grp)
         AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT end_date FROM longest_grp))
  / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM cities 
   WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir' 
   AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT start_date FROM longest_grp)
   AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT end_date FROM longest_grp)) AS proportion

-- Full query with YoY growth percentages, running_total as integer
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        CASE CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
            WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
        END AS month_name,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_total
    FROM cities
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5, 6)
    GROUP BY year, 
        CASE CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)
            WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
        END
),
with_running AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month_name,
        monthly_total,
        CAST(SUM(monthly_total) OVER (
            PARTITION BY month_name 
            ORDER BY year 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS INTEGER) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_counts
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month_name,
        monthly_total,
        running_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_name ORDER BY year) AS prev_monthly_total,
        LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_name ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM with_running
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month_name,
    monthly_total,
    running_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_monthly_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_monthly_total != 0 
        THEN ROUND(1.0 * (monthly_total - prev_monthly_total) / prev_monthly_total * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS monthly_total_yoy_growth_pct,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total != 0 
        THEN ROUND(1.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS running_total_yoy_growth_pct
FROM with_growth
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY month_name, year

WITH clean_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, order_time) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
recipe_with_extras AS (
    SELECT 
        c.row_id,
        c.order_id,
        c.customer_id,
        c.pizza_id,
        c.exclusions,
        c.extras,
        c.order_time,
        n.pizza_name,
        r.toppings as recipe_toppings
    FROM clean_orders c
    JOIN pizza_names n ON c.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON c.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
),
recipe_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(elem))::VARCHAR as topping_id
    FROM recipe_with_extras,
         UNNEST(string_split(recipe_toppings, ',')) AS t(elem)
),
exclusion_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(elem))::VARCHAR as exclusion_id
    FROM recipe_with_extras,
         UNNEST(string_split(NULLIF(exclusions, ''), ',')) AS t(elem)
),
extra_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(elem))::VARCHAR as extra_id
    FROM recipe_with_extras,
         UNNEST(string_split(NULLIF(extras, ''), ',')) AS t(elem)
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
           topping_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM recipe_topping_ids
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
           extra_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM extra_topping_ids
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, extra_id
),
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT a.row_id, a.order_id, a.customer_id, a.pizza_id, a.order_time, a.pizza_name,
           a.topping_id, a.cnt - COALESCE(e.cnt, 0) as final_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
               topping_id, SUM(cnt) as cnt
        FROM all_toppings
        GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_id
    ) a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
               exclusion_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM exclusion_topping_ids
        GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, exclusion_id
    ) e ON a.row_id = e.row_id AND a.topping_id = e.exclusion_id
    WHERE (a.cnt - COALESCE(e.cnt, 0)) > 0
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT 
        f.row_id, f.order_id, f.customer_id, f.pizza_id, f.order_time, f.pizza_name,
        t.topping_name,
        CASE WHEN f.final_cnt > 1 THEN f.final_cnt::VARCHAR || 'x ' || t.topping_name 
             ELSE t.topping_name END as display_name,
        f.final_cnt
    FROM final_toppings f
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON f.topping_id = t.topping_id::BIGINT
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
        string_agg(display_name, ', ' ORDER BY 
            CASE WHEN final_cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            display_name) as ingredients
    FROM formatted
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id

WITH delivered_pizzas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = ''
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS total_quantity
FROM delivered_pizzas dp
JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON dp.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT TRIM(unnest(string_split(pr.toppings, ',')))::INT AS topping_id
) AS t
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON t.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name

-- Calculate total income
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pco.pizza_id = 1 THEN 12
            WHEN pco.pizza_id = 2 THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END
        + 
        CASE 
            WHEN pco.extras IS NOT NULL AND pco.extras != '' THEN 
                (LENGTH(pco.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(pco.extras, ',', '')) + 1)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) as total_income
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
) pco
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders pro ON pco.order_id = pro.order_id
WHERE (pro.cancellation IS NULL OR pro.cancellation = '')
AND pco.pizza_id IN (1, 2)

WITH all_months AS (
    SELECT month_start FROM (
        VALUES (DATE '2020-01-01'), (DATE '2020-02-01'), (DATE '2020-03-01'), (DATE '2020-04-01')
    ) AS t(month_start)
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        m.month_start,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -t.txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) as monthly_change
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t 
        ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id 
        AND date_trunc('month', t.txn_date::DATE) = m.month_start
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.month_start
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_change,
        SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as closing_balance
    FROM customer_monthly
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    monthly_change,
    closing_balance
FROM with_cumulative
ORDER BY customer_id, month_start

WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) 
        - SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_balance_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_month_end_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_balance_count,
        avg_month_end_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_month_end_balance FROM ranked WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_month_end_balance FROM ranked WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference
FROM ranked
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance
    FROM cumulative
),
most_recent AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
    FROM with_prev
),
growth AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        closing_balance,
        prev_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM most_recent
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100, 2) AS pct_customers_with_growth_over_5
FROM growth
WHERE prev_balance IS NOT NULL;

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR) as txn_month,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) as month_net
    FROM customer_transactions

)

WITH RECURSIVE all_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' as cal_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cal_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM all_dates
    WHERE cal_date < DATE '2020-04-28'
),
customer_date_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, d.cal_date
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) c
    CROSS JOIN all_dates d
),
daily_net AS (
    SELECT cdp.customer_id, cdp.cal_date,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE -ct.txn_amount END), 0) as daily_net
    FROM customer_date_pairs cdp
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON cdp.customer_id = ct.customer_id AND cdp.cal_date = ct.txn_date
    GROUP BY cdp.customer_id, cdp.cal_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_net,
           SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as balance
    FROM daily_net
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, balance,
           AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_30
    FROM running_balance
),
monthly_data AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, balance, 
           rolling_avg_30,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date) as month_start,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as day_num
    FROM rolling_avg
),
first_months AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(month_start) as first_month
    FROM monthly_data
    WHERE day_num >= 30
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT md.customer_id, md.month_start, 
           GREATEST(md.rolling_avg_30, 0) as rolling_avg_30_clamped
    FROM monthly_data md
    JOIN first_months fm ON md.customer_id = fm.customer_id
    WHERE md.day_num >= 30
      AND md.month_start != fm.first_month
),
max_per_customer_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start,
           MAX(rolling_avg_30_clamped) as max_rolling_avg
    FROM filtered_data
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
sum_per_month AS (
    SELECT month_start,
           SUM(max_rolling_avg) as total_max_avg
    FROM max_per_customer_month
    GROUP BY month_start
    ORDER BY month_start
)
SELECT * FROM sum_per_month

customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           CAST(MIN(txn_date) AS DATE) as min_date, 
           CAST(MAX(txn_date) AS DATE) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_dates AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, d.cal_date
    FROM customer_date_ranges c
    JOIN date_series d ON d.cal_date >= c.min_date AND d.cal_date <= c.max_date
),
daily_txn AS (
    SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as cal_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as daily_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
daily_balance_with_txn AS (
    SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.cal_date,
           COALESCE(dt.daily_change, 0) as daily_change
    FROM customer_dates cd
    LEFT JOIN daily_txn dt ON cd.customer_id = dt.customer_id AND cd.cal_date = dt.cal_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_change,
           SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as balance
    FROM daily_balance_with_txn
),
clamped_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_change,
           GREATEST(balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM running_balance
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date) as month,
           MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM clamped_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date)
),
monthly_total AS (

),

-- Alternative approach: join cohort with terms and check overlap
WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start::DATE as first_term_start
  FROM first_terms
  WHERE first_term_start >= '1917-01-01' AND first_term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_offsets AS (
  SELECT k as year_offset FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS t(k)
),
-- For each cohort member and year offset, compute the check date
check_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    c.id_bioguide,
    c.first_term_start,
    y.year_offset,
    (c.first_term_start + CAST(y.year_offset AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE as check_date
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN year_offsets y
),
-- For each check, find if any term covers that date
retained AS (
  SELECT 
    cd.id_bioguide,
    cd.year_offset,
    cd.check_date,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= cd.check_date AND lt.term_end::DATE >= cd.check_date THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM check_dates cd
  LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = cd.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY cd.id_bioguide, cd.year_offset, cd.check_date
)
SELECT 
  year_offset,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(retained) as retained_count,
  1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
FROM retained
GROUP BY year_offset
ORDER BY year_offset

legislators_with_terms AS (

    FROM legislators l

),
year_ranges AS (

all_years AS (

serving_years AS (

-- Fixed query: states where both M and F have non-zero retention at all 6 intervals
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        lt.state,
        l.gender,
        TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as start_date,
        CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as start_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,
        ft.gender,
        y.year_interval,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
            AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= DATE(ft.start_year + y.year_interval || '-12-31'::VARCHAR)
            AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) >= DATE(ft.start_year + y.year_interval || '-12-31'::VARCHAR)
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (0), (2), (4), (6), (8), (10)) AS y(year_interval)
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender, year_interval, 
           AVG(retained * 1.0) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_interval
),
qualified_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING 
        -- All male retention rates must be > 0
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) = 1
        AND
        -- All female retention rates must be > 0
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) = 1
        AND
        -- Must have data for both genders at all 6 intervals
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'M' AND retention_rate > 0 THEN year_interval END) = 6
        AND
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'F' AND retention_rate > 0 THEN year_interval END) = 6
)
SELECT * FROM qualified_states ORDER BY state

WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment
    FROM payment

),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
),
customer_early AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_date <= cfp.first_payment + INTERVAL '168' HOUR) as early_7d,
           SUM(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_date <= cfp.first_payment + INTERVAL '720' HOUR) as early_30d
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cfp ON p.customer_id = cfp.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * c.early_7d / cl.total_ltv * 100) as avg_pct_7d,
    AVG(1.0 * c.early_30d / cl.total_ltv * 100) as avg_pct_30d,
    AVG(cl.total_ltv) as avg_ltv

with_lag AS (

WITH distinct_words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words 
  FROM word_list 
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL AND words != ''
),
word_chars AS (
  SELECT words, 
         LENGTH(words) AS word_len,
         STRING_AGG(ch, '' ORDER BY ch) AS sorted_chars
  FROM (
    SELECT words, 
           SUBSTR(words, n, 1) AS ch
    FROM distinct_words t,
    LATERAL (SELECT * FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(words)))) AS gs(n)
  ) sub
  GROUP BY words
),
all_anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT words, 
         word_len, 
         sorted_chars,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sorted_chars) AS total_anagram_count
  FROM word_chars
),
filtered_words AS (
  SELECT words, word_len, sorted_chars, total_anagram_count
  FROM all_anagram_counts
  WHERE word_len BETWEEN 4 AND 5 
    AND words LIKE 'r%'

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaves AS (
    SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        SUM(pt.accumulated_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaves l ON l.id = pt.current_id
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT p.id AS top_id, pr.contains_id, CAST(pr.qty AS BIGINT) AS level_qty, 1 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT h.top_id, pr.contains_id, CAST(h.level_qty AS BIGINT) * pr.qty, h.depth + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.contains_id = pr.packaging_id
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        contains_id,
        CAST(SUM(level_qty) AS BIGINT) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    GROUP BY top_id, contains_id
    HAVING SUM(level_qty) > 500
)
SELECT 
    p_top.name AS container_name,
    p_item.name AS item_name,
    t.total_qty
FROM totals t
JOIN packaging p_top ON t.top_id = p_top.id
JOIN packaging p_item ON t.contains_id = p_item.id
ORDER BY p_top.name, p_item.name;

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as time_step,
           EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) as month_num,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) as year_num
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step, s.month_num, s.year_num,
           (
               SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) 
               FROM monthly_sales s2 
               WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id 
               AND CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) 
                   BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 11 
                   AND CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 6
           ) as window1,
           (
               SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) 
               FROM monthly_sales s2 
               WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id 
               AND CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s2.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) 
                   BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 12 
                   AND CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(s.mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 5
           ) as window2
    FROM sales s
),
with_ratio AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty, time_step, month_num, year_num,
           (window1 + window2) / 2.0 as cma,
           CASE WHEN (window1 + window2) / 2.0 != 0 THEN qty / ((window1 + window2) / 2.0) ELSE NULL END as ratio
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonal_indices AS (
    SELECT product_id, month_num,
           AVG(ratio) as seasonal_index
    FROM with_ratio
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
deseasonalized AS (
    SELECT s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step, s.month_num, s.year_num, si.seasonal_index,
           CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index != 0 AND si.seasonal_index IS NOT NULL 
                THEN s.qty * 1.0 / si.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END as deseasonalized_qty
    FROM sales s
    JOIN seasonal_indices si ON s.product_id = si.product_id AND s.month_num = si.month_num
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           SUM(time_step) as sum_w,
           SUM(time_step * time_step) as sum_wx,
           SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wy,
           SUM(time_step * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wxy
    FROM deseasonalized
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum_wy * 1.0 / sum_w as y_bar,
           sum_wx * 1.0 / sum_w as x_bar,
           (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy * 1.0 / sum_w) as numerator,
           (sum_wx - sum_wx * sum_wx * 1.0 / sum_w) as denominator
    FROM weighted_stats
),
final_params AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           numerator / denominator as slope,
           y_bar - (numerator / denominator) * x_bar as intercept
    FROM regression_params
)
SELECT product_id, slope, intercept FROM final_params

),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT tdr.year, tdr.constructor_id, tdr.driver_id, 
           TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as tdr_rank
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    WHERE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT ds.race_id, lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
)
SELECT cs.constructor_name, cs.year, cs.constr_points,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as best_driver_name, ds.driver_points,
       cs.constr_points + ds.driver_points as combined_points
FROM constructor_season cs
JOIN best_driver bd ON cs.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND cs.year = bd.year
JOIN driver_season ds ON bd.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND cs.year = ds.year
JOIN drivers d ON bd.driver_id = d.driver_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (cs.constr_points + ds.driver_points) DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC;

-- Get all distinct driver names who meet the criteria in any season during the 1950s
WITH qualifying_drivers AS (
  SELECT 
    r.year,
    dr.driver_id,
    dr.constructor_id,
    r.round,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, dr.driver_id ORDER BY r.round) as rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, dr.driver_id ORDER BY r.round DESC) as rn_desc
  FROM results dr
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = dr.race_id
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying_drivers dr
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dr.driver_id
GROUP BY dr.year, dr.driver_id, d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dr.round) >= 2
  AND MIN(CASE WHEN dr.rn_asc = 1 THEN dr.constructor_id END) = MIN(CASE WHEN dr.rn_desc = 1 THEN dr.constructor_id END)
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename

-- Check all drives for driver 624 in 1956
SELECT year, driver_id, drive_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round, is_first_drive_of_season, is_final_drive_of_season
FROM drives
WHERE year = 1956 AND driver_id = 624
ORDER BY first_round

-- Check the 12 cases where retirement lap matches a Race lap
SELECT r.race_id, r.driver_id, r.lap as retire_lap, lp.lap as race_lap, lp.position, lp.lap_type
FROM retirements r
JOIN lap_positions lp ON r.race_id = lp.race_id 
    AND r.driver_id = lp.driver_id 
    AND r.lap = CAST(lp.lap AS VARCHAR)
    AND lp.lap_type = 'Race'
LIMIT 20
